Proof in the paper: The XRD patterns (Figure 1A) show a series of diffraction peaks at 2θ of 10.5°, 20.8°, 31.4°, 37.8°, and 55.6°, which can be indexed to a characteristic feature of the layered CaxAl-NO3––LDH phase. Moreover, the cell parameters of re-CaxAl-LDH (listed in Table 1) are calculated based on (003) and (110) reflection as c = ∼22.50 Å and a = ∼3.30 Å, respectively, which are in accordance with the characteristics of OH– intercalated CaxAl-LDH.
